machine_end_gcode.default_value:
;End GCode
M104 T0 S0 ;extruder heater off
M104 T1 S0 ;extruder heater off
M140 S0 ;heated bed heater off
M141 S0 ;chamber heater off
M144 ;ring heater off
G91 ;relative positioning
G1 E-1 F300 ;retract the filament a bit before lifting the nozzle, to release some of the pressure
G1 Z+0.5 E-5 F3000 ;move Z up a bit and retract filament even more
G28;move X/Y to min endstops, so the head is out of the way
M84 ;steppers off
M107
G90 ;absolute positioning

M300 S0 P333
M300 S880 P166
M300 S880 P166
M300 S1318 P166
M300 S1567 P166
M300 S0 P166
M300 S880 P166
M300 S0 P166
M300 S880 P166
M300 S0 P166
M300 S880 P166
M300 S0 P166
M300 S1567 P166
M300 S0 P166
M300 S880 P166

machine_start_gcode.default_value:
;Machine Model: {machine_name} 
;Nozzle Size: {str(extruderValue(-1, 'machine_nozzle_size'))}
;Sliced at: {day} {date} {time}
G21 ;metric values
M107
G28
M420 S1
G90 ;absolute positioning
G1 X0 Y0 Z5 F5000 ;move nozzle up 5mm for safe homing
G29;ABL
M500
M82 ;set extruder to absolute mode
M107 ;start with the fan off

;Ring Heater Control
{'M143 S' + str(int(ring_heater_power * 2.55)) + ' ;Set ring heater power' if ring_heater_enable else ';Ring heater disabled'}

;Build Volume Temperature
{'M141 S' + str(build_volume_temperature) + ' ;Set chamber temperature' if build_volume_temperature > 0 else ';Chamber heating disabled'}

G1 X0 Y0 Z15.0 F5000 ;move the platform down 15mm

; Extrude purge line

G92 E0 ; reset extruder position
G0 Z0.2 F500 ; purge
G0 X15 E2.5 F500 ; purge
G92 E0 ; reset extruder position
G0 X25 E2.5 F650 ; purge
G92 E0 ; reset extruder position
G0 X35 E2.5 F800 ; purge
G0 X{35 + 3} Z{0.05} F{8000} ; wipe, move close to the bed
G0 X{35 + 3 * 2} Z0.2 F{8000} ; wipe, move quickly away from the bed

G92 E0 ; zero the extruded length again
M117 Printing...

M300 S880 P166
M300 S0 P166
M300 S880 P166
M300 S1318 P166
M300 S1567 P166
M300 S0 P166
